planets.name: HAT-P-41 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-41 with a 2.69-day year, found in 2012.

text.card: HAT-P-41 b was found in 2012 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-41. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname STASSUN_ET_AL__2017): disc_year 2012, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.6940497, pl_radj 2.05, pl_bmassj 1.19

thermal.source: Deming et al. 2023, dayside brightness temperature at 4.5 µm (uniform reanalysis of Spitzer's eclipses, CDS J/AJ/165/104 table 2)
thermal.chosen: 2 measured of 2 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength
